tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Ruijie RG-EW1200G PRO 1300M Dual-Band Gigabit WiFi Router delivers exceptional wireless performance with combined speeds of up to 1300Mbps across the 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. Designed with advanced Reyee Mesh capability, this router allows you to expand coverage seamlessly using multiple Reyee devices, ensuring whole-home WiFi with stable connectivity and zero dead zones.

Equipped with full Gigabit Ethernet ports, the EW1200G PRO ensures maximum internet speed for high-bandwidth applications like online gaming, 4K video streaming, IPTV, and heavy downloads. Its powerful 4 high-gain antennas and Beamforming technology enhance signal strength and coverage, making it ideal for apartments, homes, and small offices in Bangladesh.

With robust security features, easy setup via the Ruijie Cloud App, and intelligent management options, the Ruijie RG-EW1200G PRO is a reliable and high-performance WiFi solution for any modern smart home.


Key Features

  • Dual-Band WiFi (2.4GHz + 5GHz) delivering speeds up to 1300Mbps
  • Reyee Mesh Technology for whole-home mesh WiFi expansion
  • Full Gigabit WAN/LAN Ports for maximum wired performance
  • 4 High-Gain Antennas providing strong coverage and stable connectivity
  • Beamforming Technology improves signal direction and range
  • Supports Up to 64 Devices simultaneously
  • Easy App Control via Ruijie Cloud for remote management
  • Enhanced Network Security with WPA3, Guest Network, Parental Control
  • MU-MIMO Support for efficient multi-device performance
  • Ideal For: 4K streaming, online gaming, IPTV, and smart home setups
